reason: Both earlier findings are resolved: the normalization proof establishes measurability and positivity before invoking the density-measure result, and the algorithm definition no longer contains the path-law proof; that result is stated and proved in the finite-state theorem. The cutoff score-matching argument and finite CD calculations remain sound. The local cutoff proof is distinct from Hyvärinen’s source theorem, which assumes a pointwise boundary condition ([paper](https://jmlr.csail.mit.edu/papers/volume6/hyvarinen05a/hyvarinen05a.pdf)); Hinton’s source supports the stated omitted-derivative caveat ([guide](https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~hinton/absps/guideTR.pdf)).
